subject: SUPERSEDE / READY_FOR_PRIMARY: fix INNER wake generation race + gate opening visual on same-attempt wake/readiness
body: Manager independently verified the current-main race. Fold7ContinuityController increments generation on every state transition; OPENING_FROM_CLOSED normally transitions to INNER_HANDOFF at innerActive or >=8deg. Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.wakeInner queues Dispatchers.IO and rechecks the old generation inside the worker before Binder. FoldOverlayService starts gen3Visual immediately after entering OPENING_FROM_CLOSED. Therefore the visible opening can begin before Binder wake starts, and a normal handoff can advance generation and cause the queued required wake to self-cancel. This supersedes the earlier instrumentation-only disposition. READY_FOR_PRIMARY runtime candidate with field gate: mint (serviceEpoch, openingAttemptSequence) at accepted opening; preserve wake-intent lifetime across ordinary INNER_HANDOFF; one-shot attempt-scoped wake commit immediately before shell mutation; revoke only true cancellation/reversal/privilege loss/destroy; split opening visual into immediate bounded prelude then promote only after WAKE_COMMITTED and release continuity only on stronger same-attempt logical/presentation/useful readiness; propagate attempt identity through all wake/readiness milestones. Evaluate a dedicated low-jitter wake executor only after correctness. Physical Fold7 A/B remains mandatory before final acceptance.
